prompt:
Write a short conversation (4 to 10 turns) between someone new to the city and an assistant about baking (bread, cakes, cookies, dough, rising and baking times). The person asks for something but leaves out a detail the assistant needs, and the assistant asks a short question to get it; or the person asks for something the assistant can't do, and it says so politely. Start each turn on a new line with "Person:" or "Assistant:".
Use the noun "work", the verb "pair" and the adjective "noisy" somewhere (any form of them is fine, like a plural or the past tense).
Include two requests in one sentence.
Use simple, everyday English. Write only the text itself: no title, no notes, and no angle brackets.
